# E & B Hair

> Braiding salon at 171 Princess Rd, Manchester M14 4RL: knotless braids, box braids, cornrows, twists, loc grooming, children's hair and treatments. Services, starting prices and estimated durations come from the salon's WubSync booking system.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eandbhair.co.uk/): Salon overview and popular services.
- [Services & prices](https://eandbhair.co.uk/services): Every current service by category, with starting price and estimated duration.
- [Gallery](https://eandbhair.co.uk/gallery): Style inspiration by category.
- [Contact](https://eandbhair.co.uk/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, enquiry form and map.

## Booking

- [Book online](https://booking.eandbhair.co.uk/book/eandb): Choose a service, options, date and time. The final price is confirmed there.
